confirmed: Original HB35 says main turret length over all. HB43 identifies apertures and turret regions but supplies no explicit endpoints for that length.
hypothesis: Inclusive length: main body 2451.1 plus driver projection 685.8 gives the printed3136.9. Preserve the old main-body center, infer longitudinal feature stations proportionally, and leave all printed feature sizes unscaled.
nonconfirmation: The phrase over all alone does not establish the endpoint interpretation. The improved whole-section envelope is corroborative only within the original conditional scale and provisional configuration transfer.
